integrity: Exact rational character inner products from exhaustive finite simplicial traces and verified mod-two boundary ranks; no independent expert validation.
scientific_limitations: Only rational B4-modules of the four-cube intrinsic graph Čech nerve at scale 3; nonequivariant homology ranks previously published; no integral module classification, higher-dimensional cube theorem, or equivariant homotopy classification.
title: The hyperoctahedral homology character of the four-cube Čech nerve at scale three
